Audio pass 4 — soft hover voice + colour-keyed terz cadence. (1) The hover voice was a buzzy sawtooth+vibrato ('annoying fly'); replaced with a SOFT pad: two gently detuned sine/triangle oscillators through a mellow lowpass, no vibrato, soft swell, tuned only slightly (~±¾ semitone) by position along the line. (2) Reworked the placement cadence to be a TERZ (stacked-thirds) progression keyed to the FLOWER COLOUR, with the PLAYER setting major/minor: COLOR_ROOTS (F4..E5, one per colour) + triadFor(color,player) → [root, third(maj/min), fifth]. select=root, hover/glide=soft third, place=fifth; TAKING flowers (any flight: placement pair, claim, free pick, steal) now rings the whole CHORD of that colour's terz (replaced the old two-tone chime); pickup=chord too; win=rising flourish in the winner's quality. AudioController threads the flower colour (selected star / lastPlace / last flight) and player into every cue. SFX stay clear of the music bands (roots 349-659 → fifths ≤989). tsc clean, 69 Vitest pass, build OK, Playwright green.

Audio pass 3 — drier placement, dynamic background, violin hover, per-player major/minor, distinct SFX/music bands. (1) Reverb cut on placement: note() no longer sends to the delay; sfxWet 0.16->0.06. (2) Background now PROGRESSES + has shape: drones glide through a bass loop A2-F2-C3-G2 (advanceHarmony every ~16-25s) and a ~75s intensity swell rides density/loudness/chord+sparkle probability + a gentle musicGain wobble. (3) Hover = a bowed VIOLIN string: a sustained sawtooth-through-lowpass with vibrato whose pitch bends with the preview's position along the line (AudioController computes t via projection); released on leave/place. (4) Per-player tonality: TRIADS — Gold C-major, Silver C-MINOR (same notes, minor third), Rose D-minor, Fern G-major; select/hover/place/pickup/win all voiced in the current (or winning) player's key. (5) SFX vs music kept in separate registers to avoid confusion: SFX mid-band (~390-990 Hz), music plucks/chords low (<=330) + sparkles high (>=1046). tsc clean, 69 Vitest pass, build OK, Playwright green.

Audio pass 2 — volume sliders + richer bed + placement cadence. (1) Per-channel volume: AppSettings musicVolume/sfxVolume (0..1, persisted) with sliders in Settings under each toggle; engine setMusicVolume (ramps musicGain to MUSIC_MAX*v) / setSfxVolume (scales sfxGain by SFX_MAX*v), synced live via AudioController. (2) Richer background: added an A1 sub-bass drone, an airy looped-white-noise wash through an LFO-swept lowpass, slow soft chord swells (root+fifth+octave, ~40% per window), and occasional faint two-partial bell shimmers (~32%) — on top of the existing root+fifth drone + pentatonic plucks. (3) Flower-click 3-tone progression (per user): selecting a flower = tone1 (C5), the first preview snap to a line = tone2 (E5), placing the pawn = tone3 (G5) — an ascending C-major cadence; reclaiming a pawn plays all three as a chord; setup claim / free picks / Dusk steal still ring the collect chime. AudioController diffs selection.aStarId + selection.hover (gated once per selection) + beacon count (up=place, down=pickup) + flights (collect when no placement). tsc clean, 69 Vitest pass, build OK, Playwright green (settings screenshot round-4/20 shows the sliders).

Added a 'strength ladder' sim test (seats alternated): Hard beats Medium 78-84%, Medium>Low ~100%, Hard>Low ~100% — the ladder now genuinely climbs. Procrastinator nudged to first-placement-only. Audio pass 5 - simplified placement cadence; removed the hover/tuning voice entirely (per user: no soft-pad tone while gliding the line). The colour-keyed terz now arpeggiates across the three discrete actions only: select a flower = root, place the pawn = third, and TAKING the flowers rings the fifth ~0.5s later (note() gained a delaySec arg; collect = note(fifth, 0.3, 0.5)). Reclaiming your own pawn still rings the whole chord; win = rising flourish in the winner's quality. Deleted the bow/bowOn/bowGlide/bowStop methods, the bowOsc/bowOsc2/bowGain fields, the 'hover' SfxName, and the setSfx bowStop call; AudioController dropped every audio.bow() call plus the hover projection block. Settings SFX hint text updated. tsc clean, 69 Vitest pass, build OK, dev server on 3100 live (HMR).

Audio pass 6 - nightfall symphony + PIANO timbre + explicit Gold-major/Silver-minor. (1) New 'harvest' SFX: at the end-game flower assignment, each leftover flower rings its colour's WHOLE chord (terz) in its owner's quality as it's claimed (~190ms apart) so the harvest animation plays as a building final symphony, then the win flourish; AudioController fires it off the monotonic reveal counter (the flights array churns as flights land), gated on revealAuto so scrubbing the timeline is silent and Replay re-rings. (2) Voice changed from plain sine to a synth-PIANO: note() is now additive (6 harmonic partials, percussive ~5ms attack, decays that shorten with partial number, slight inharmonicity); ALL terz cues (select/place/collect/pickup/harvest) and the win flourish use it. (3) Added a DynamicsCompressor limiter on the SFX bus so overlapping harvest chords never clip. (4) Confirmed/clarified triadFor: Gold seat (even) always MAJOR, Silver seat (odd) the same root MINOR. tsc clean, 69 Vitest pass, build OK, dev server on 3100 live (HMR).

Audio pass 7 - WARM SOFT SYNTH voice + fixed background-music controls + atmosphere match. (1) Replaced the piano voice: note() is now a warm pad — a triangle fundamental + a gently detuned sine (chorus) + a faint sub-octave, through a mellow lowpass (cutoff = freq*5, cap 3000), with a soft ~40ms swell-in (not a pluck) and a long ~1.4s smooth release. All terz cues + win flourish use it; matches the music's triangle-through-lowpass palette. (2) FIXED 'music toggle + slider don't work': proved via a Playwright probe (exposed audio on the dev seam + added snapshot()) that the engine AND the real UI controls drive the music graph correctly in-browser, so the real-world failure was the autoplay race — unlock()/setMusic() started the drone oscillators before AudioContext.resume() resolved, so Chrome dropped them and the padTimer guard then blocked every retry, leaving music permanently silent. Added whenRunning(fn) that resumes the context THEN starts the drones; unlock() and setMusic(true) route through it. (3) Atmosphere: the nightfall harvest symphony chords now send through the shared feedback-delay reverb (tail=true) so they bloom into the music's space (placement stays dry/crisp). (4) Added DynamicsCompressor limiter on the SFX bus (pass 6) keeps the overlapping warm chords from clipping. New e2e audio-probe.spec.ts asserts gesture-starts-music + checkbox/slider wiring end-to-end. tsc clean, 69 Vitest pass, build OK, Playwright 10/10 green, dev server on 3100 live (HMR).

Audio pass 8 - fixed Gold-major/Silver-minor attribution + clearer quality + slower harvest. (1) ROOT-CAUSE of 'gold and silver sound the same': the major/minor lives only in the triad's THIRD, which is voiced on the 'place' cue — but AudioController passed g.current, and finishOrStay advances the turn on placement, so the third was attributed to the NEXT player (constant/wrong quality).
